scene_prompt: Eye-level close-up of a confident Latina woman with dark hair. She leans against the marble bar of an upscale restaurant, one elbow resting on the counter, a cocktail glass held loosely at her side, looking directly into the camera — unbothered, like she owns the room. Wearing a fitted black satin slip dress with a deep V neckline, thin gold chain at her collarbone, black stiletto heels, one ankle crossed over the other. Behind her — warm amber bar lighting, dark wood shelves lined with bottles, candles flickering softly on the bar top. Shot on a Contax T2, Kodak Ektar 100, 38mm f/2.8, shallow depth of field, soft halation from the candlelight. Keep her face, hair, and body exactly the same.
caption: table for one. obviously 🖤
